svg.title: One walking window becomes 264 tokens
svg.desc: Laptop profile: 32 frames, 33 landmarks and three channels. Group four frames of one landmark into 12 numbers, project to 96 features, then add joint and time information. The grid has eight time blocks and 33 landmarks: 264 tokens.
